atoms.sound: I wake up at 7 a.m., get dressed, and pray. I eat breakfast and brush my teeth. Then, I take the train to school.
After school, I go to the mosque with my family. I help my mum cook dinner. I do my homework and get ready for bed.
I wake up at 7:00am every morning. Then I get dressed and eat breakfast.

atoms.a: What time does Fatima wake up?
b: ++She wakes up at 7:00 a.m. every morning.
She wakes up at 10:00 a.m. every morning.
She wakes up at 7:00 a.m. only on Mondays.

atoms.a: What does she do after she wakes up?
b: She eats breakfast and then gets dressed.
++She gets dressed and then eats breakfast.
She gets dressed breakfast.

atoms.sound: After I eat breakfast, I brush my teeth and take the bus to school.

atoms.a: What does Fatima do after she eats breakfast?
b: ++She brushes her teeth and goes to school.
She brushes her school and goes to teeth.
She goes to school and brushes her teeth there.

atoms.a: How does she get to school in the morning?
b: ++She takes the bus to school.
Her parents drive her to school.
She walks to school.

atoms.sound: After school, I go to football training. After training, I make dinner with my dad.

atoms.a: What sport does Rhys play after school?
atoms.sound: What sport does Reece play after school?
b: ++Rhys plays football.
Rhys plays basketball.
Rhys plays hockey.

atoms.a: Who does he make dinner with after training?
b: ++He makes dinner with his dad.
He makes dinner with his mum.
He makes dinner with his brother.

atoms.sound: After dinner, I do my chores and then do my homework. At 9:30pm I get ready for bed and go to sleep.

atoms.a: When does Reece do his homework?
atoms.sound: When does Rhys do his homework?
b: ++He does his homework after he finishes his chores.
He does his homework before his chores.
He does his homework before dinner.

atoms.a: When does he get ready for bed?
b: ++Rhys gets ready for bed at 9:30 p.m.
Rhys gets ready for bed at 8:00 p.m.
Rhys gets ready for bed at 9:00 a.m.

atoms.sound: I wake up at 6:30, get dressed and eat breakfast with my little sister... - I brush my teeth and pack my lunch. - Then I ride my bike to school. After school, I go to football training. I have dinner with my grandmother, do my homework, and then I do my chores. I get ready for bed at 9:00pm.

atoms.a: Dhruv eats breakfast with his little brother.
atoms.sound: Dhroov eats breakfast with his little brother.

atoms.a: Dhruv rides his bike to school.
atoms.sound: Dhroov rides his bike to school.

atoms.a: After school, Dhruv goes to tennis training.

atoms.a: Dhruv eats dinner with his grandmother.
atoms.sound: Dhroov eats dinner with his grandmother.

atoms.a: Dhruv does his chores after he finishes his homework.
atoms.sound: Dhroov does his chores after he finishes his homework.
